By demanding public hearings, the committee shifts from private patronage to public scrutiny, reducing the power of secret influence.

The Trajectory: The Path of Awakening.

The Unavoidable Truth: Political appointments often bypass standard vetting.

The Unavoidable Lie: The system was designed to be transparent.
